brief: Write a 200-word email from Priya Raman to the Harlow Street tenants' group. Facts: the boiler was replaced on 14 October 2025 by Kessler Heating; it cost £8,450; 23 of 31 flats reported no heating for 6 days; the landlord may refund part of the service charge, but nothing is confirmed. Contact: repairs@harlowstreet.example.

Write a 200-word README introduction for an open-source tool called Tidepool that syncs photo folders. Facts: written in Go; version 2.3 released 5 May 2026; tested on about 40,000 files; roughly 3 times faster than version 1 in the author's own tests, which may not hold on slow disks; docs at https://tidepool.example/docs.

Write a 220-word summary of a school reading programme for a governors' report. Facts: ran September 2025 to March 2026 at Elm Park Primary; 112 pupils in Years 3 and 4; average reading age rose by 7 months; 18 pupils made no measurable progress; headteacher Joan Whitlock said "the early signs are encouraging but we need another year of data"; cost £14 per pupil.

Write a 220-word blog post about switching a bakery to a four-day week. Facts: Marta's Bakery in Leeds, owner Marta Kowalczyk; started 2 February 2026; 9 staff; sales fell about 4% in the first month then recovered; two staff said they sleep better; she is not sure it will survive the Christmas rush.

Write a 180-word product description for the Fennel 3 bicycle light. Facts: 800 lumens; battery lasts up to 6 hours on low; charges by USB-C in 2 hours; weighs 96 grams; rated IPX6, which means heavy rain but not being submerged; price $49; 2-year warranty.

Write a 180-word LinkedIn post by Daniel Okafor about finishing a data analyst course. Facts: 14-week evening course at Northgate College, finished 20 June 2026; built a dashboard on bus delays using 1.2 million rows of open data; found delays were about 30% worse on rainy days, though he only had one winter of data; he is looking for a junior role in Manchester.

Write a 200-word cover letter paragraph for Aiko Tanaka applying to be a project coordinator at Brightwater Housing. Facts: 5 years at Linden Care; ran a move of 60 staff to a new office in 2024, finished 2 weeks late and 3% under budget; holds a PRINCE2 Foundation certificate; speaks Japanese and Spanish.

Write a 200-word summary of a team meeting on 9 November 2026. Facts: attended by Sam Ortiz, Lena Fischer and Tariq Aziz; the app release moves from 1 December to 15 December; 7 open bugs, 2 of them serious; Lena thinks the login bug is probably caused by the new cache but has not confirmed it; Tariq will not be available 20 to 24 November.

Write a 220-word plain-language summary of a study. Facts: published in 2024 by Chen and Abara; 412 adults with mild insomnia; half used a breathing app for 8 weeks; the app group fell asleep about 9 minutes faster on average; the result suggests a small benefit but the study had no long-term follow-up; 37 people dropped out; cite as (Chen and Abara, 2024).

Write a 220-word press release. Facts: Castell Museum reopens its east wing on 3 April 2027 after a 19-month closure; cost €2.1 million, of which €600,000 came from the regional council; director Ines Moreau said "we expect around 90,000 visitors in the first year"; 14 new rooms; free entry on the first weekend; details at https://castellmuseum.example.

Write a 200-word item for a community garden newsletter. Facts: Ashby Road garden; the autumn sale on 18 October raised £1,340; about 150 people came; the new water butt holds 1,000 litres; volunteers Ruth and Imran built 6 raised beds; the council may cut the grant next year, a decision is expected in January.

Write a 220-word policy memo recommending a trial of remote first-line IT support. Facts: 3 help-desk staff; 1,840 tickets last quarter; about 70% were password resets; a similar trial at the Leeds office in 2025 cut average wait from 22 minutes to 9, but that office is smaller; proposed 12-week trial starting 11 January 2027; cost under £5,000.

Write a 220-word case study about a plumbing firm adopting online booking. Facts: Dunmore Plumbing, 11 employees, owner Colm Dunmore; went live 1 March 2026; missed calls fell from roughly 40 a week to 12; no-shows did not change; bookings outside office hours are now 28% of the total; Colm said "I was sceptical and I am still not sure about the fees".

Write a 180-word event announcement. Facts: Riverside Book Festival, 12 to 14 June 2026, in Shrewsbury; 34 authors including Nadia Halabi and Tom Reece; weekend pass £45, day ticket £18, under-16s free; the Saturday evening talk starts at 19:30; last year about 2,600 people attended; tickets at https://riversidebooks.example/tickets.

Write a 200-word FAQ answer to 'Is the Oakline water filter safe for well water?'. Facts: it removes at least 99% of lead and chlorine in lab tests; it does not remove bacteria or nitrates; the cartridge lasts about 400 litres or 2 months; well water should be tested first; tests were done by Hartwell Labs in 2025; it is not certified for well water.

Write a 220-word project update to stakeholders. Facts: the Canal Street bridge repair is 62% complete; originally due 30 September 2026, now expected in late November; the delay is mostly due to a steel shipment that arrived 5 weeks late; budget £3.4 million, spend so far £2.3 million; engineer Fatima Noor believes there could be one more week of delay if it rains heavily; no injuries on site.
